levels.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent isometric building sprite for an interactive Cancel City neighbourhood. NEW illustration. Reference portrait is STYLE ONLY: match its bold grotesque punk comic black ink outlines, dense scratchy crosshatching, distressed screen-printed vivid colour, textured hand-drawn details. Show ONE complete building, detached, centered, full structure visible, three-quarter isometric view from diagonally above, orthographic game camera, vertical walls upright. Two visible front/side faces meet at center; ground base is a small diamond-like isometric square. Use the same approximately 30-degree isometric view for all assets. Frame comfortably inside a square canvas with clear transparent margin, preserve room above roof. Include ONLY the building and its own narrow ground footprint, no street, no sky, no background scenery, no large shadow extending outside footprint. TRUE alpha transparent background, not white or checkerboard painted background. NO card frame, UI, captions, readable text, watermark or real logos. High detail at least 1024 square; legible silhouette at 250px. Level 1 starting building, compact and modest but expressive. Palette: teal-cyan. Subject: A ramshackle three-storey cyberpunk broadcast newsroom made from teal brick and patchwork steel, huge blank cyan billboard panels, many antennas and dish receivers, rooftop neon abstract eye symbol, tangled exterior cables, black fire escape and small glowing windows. Satirize terminally-online attention culture. No readable lettering or real company logos.
